gradingRule: score = round(100 * (pass + 0.5*partial) / features_total); a control present-but-dead (responds in UWP, dead in WinUI) is at most partial; a genuinely blank scenario (anyFrameRendered=false) is fail.

scenarios.title: Current activity
scenarios.passCriteria: Scenario reachable, 'Get Current Activity' present and responds (updates output/status) as in the UWP golden.

scenarios.title: Activity history
scenarios.passCriteria: Scenario reachable, 'Get Activity History' present and responds as in the UWP golden.

scenarios.title: Events
scenarios.passCriteria: Both buttons present; 'ReadingChanged On' responds; 'ReadingChanged Off' state must match UWP (disabled/inert until subscribed).

scenarios.title: Background activity
scenarios.passCriteria: Both buttons present; 'Register Task' must respond (update status) as in the UWP golden; 'Unregister Task' state must match UWP (disabled until registered).
